concept.title: Affordable gym and fitness classes
concept.shortdesc: As someone paying high rent, I need gyms or classes that are not expensive and fit around work, so that I can train without overspending.

conbody.note: Draft need (N-018). The needs catalogue is a model's draft from persona use cases and has not been agreed with stakeholders; the category links are proposals and are not confirmed.

section.title: The need
section.p: Who: adults on low incomes, newcomers.
Situation: Interested in strength training and HIIT; searches return paid listings, not community leisure.
A good result: Community and leisure-trust facilities and classes with prices, opening hours and concessions.
How much it matters: Convenience: a miss is an inconvenience, so the bar is lower.

ul.li: What gyms or fitness classes are there in or near Ancoats that aren't too expensive? I'm mainly into strength training and HIIT.
community leisure centre with a gym

section.title: How the draft did on this need
section.p: Model-judged, in four places, with no human check yet. See for how to read it.
